title: Guilty on All 7 Counts. Then the Supreme Court Said 9–0.

lines.say: What the jury found: guilty on all seven counts. Two officials had cut Fort Lee's bridge lanes to punish its mayor, prosecutors said, behind a fake traffic study.
lines.show: What the jury found: guilty on all seven counts. Two officials had cut Fort Lee's bridge lanes to punish its mayor, prosecutors said, behind a fake traffic study.

lines.say: What the Supreme Court found: the evidence no doubt shows wrongdoing. Deception, corruption, abuse of power.
lines.show: What the Supreme Court found: the evidence "no doubt shows wrongdoing—deception, corruption, abuse of power."

scene.cite: Kelly v. United States, opinion of the Court (U.S. May 7, 2020)

lines.say: But not every corrupt act by state or local officials is a federal crime. Reversed, nine to nothing.
lines.show: "But not every corrupt act by state or local officials is a federal crime." Reversed, 9–0.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
